# VAIB Free Phishing Email Analyzer

> A free, browser-based email phishing triage tool by VAIB Technical Tools. It analyzes pasted raw email source or local .eml files without uploading email content to a backend.

## Project
- Website: https://vaibcc.github.io/free-Phishing-Email-Analyzer/
- Source code: https://github.com/vaibcc/free-Phishing-Email-Analyzer
- License: MIT
- Technology: HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript; no build step or API key required.

## Main capabilities
- Parse common email headers: From, Reply-To, Return-Path, Subject and Received.
- Extract HTTP and HTTPS URLs.
- Flag heuristic indicators such as Reply-To/From domain mismatch, IP-address URLs, URL shorteners, HTTP links, unusual hostnames, urgency language and reported authentication failures.
- Parse SPF, DKIM and DMARC results when present in supplied Authentication-Results or Received-SPF headers.
- Produce an explainable heuristic score and export a JSON report.

## Important limitations
- Authentication results are read from supplied headers; they are not independently verified. Headers may be forged.
- The analyzer does not query DNS, validate DKIM signatures, test SPF/DMARC alignment, visit URLs, inspect binary attachments or use threat-intelligence feeds.
- Scores are heuristic and can produce false positives and false negatives. This tool is not a substitute for mail security controls or incident response.
- Email content is processed in the browser. The page currently loads Google Fonts remotely for visual styling.
